items.text: tele speaks russian and ukrainian: its pages, menus and messages follow the app language
built on telegram 13.2.1, with its native bot widgets, glass menus and new profile pages
turn off bot widgets: they keep their caption and stop running scripts and asking the network
with money turned off, wallet balances are hidden in profiles too
the language picked in settings applies to the whole interface again, tele's texts included
settings search shows every row by its own name and opens it right there
the tele menus stay as wide as their items, and their thin separators match the theme
two thin separators that meet when a row hides become one
a tele submenu opens where its own item was pressed
a diagnostic report is asked about once, and don't send keeps it away for good
scheduled suggested posts are left to telegram instead of failing with an error
